name: zclass_render_traversal_state_globals
description: zClass render traversal state globals preserve render callback, clip-mask, alpha, software-path, LOD, bounds, and range-fade state across traversal dispatch.
known_limits: Pure code/function tier S byte work for the coherent zClass render traversal source cluster remains globally deferred; data-entry S follows local owner/data/byte gates.
functional_evidence: The native render traversal dispatch smoke saves, mutates, observes, and restores the render traversal globals used by object, camera, light, sound, animate, LOD, sequence, and switch traversal paths.

The smoke verifies alpha-scale and vertex-alpha state propagation, clip-mask stack restoration, bounds-context restoration, software-path and LOD stack restoration, range-fade DI side effects, variant rejection, and matrix-stack restoration.
